The reported topic 'Innovation & Digital Transformation' does not semantically align with any GRI 11 base topics, which focus on environmental, social, and governance issues rather than technological innovation.

11.2 covers climate adaptation and transition, aligning with low carbon energy as a mitigation strategy. 11.1 (GHG emissions) is a result, not the solution. 11.14 (economic impacts) is less directly relevant.

National Talent Enhancement focuses on workforce development, which is not explicitly covered by any GRI 11 base topic. Employment practices (11.10) relates to workplace conditions, not national-level talent strategies.

11.8 covers asset integrity and incident management, directly related to operational reliability. Other topics focus on environmental, social, or governance aspects not aligned with operational efficiency.

The reported topic 'Stakeholder Relations & Partnerships' does not semantically align with any GRI 11 base topic, which focuses on environmental, social, and governance issues specific to the oil and gas sector rather than general stakeholder engagement.
GRI 11 base topics address specific human rights aspects (e.g., 11.11, 11.12, 11.13) but none fully encompass the broad 'Upholding Human Rights' topic.
